mobbin:a6f030e2-5e59-4c27-80a3-a16e8cd88.summary: From an analytics page, the user opens 'Export', chooses 'Share to web', sets a password and whether viewers may use filters, then gets a link to copy.
steps: Sequences Analytics: headline boxes, funnel, weekly line, Export
Export menu: Share to web, Download, Send to email
Share your data: password field and Allow viewers to interact with filters ON
Password set; locked Set control; filter switch still on
Share link ready: explo.co/share URL, 'Copy', filter switch
steal: One 'Export' menu offers 'Share to web', 'Download' and 'Send to email' (screen 2).
The shared page needs a password, set before or together with the link (screens 3 to 5).
A switch, 'Allow viewers to interact with filters', decides whether viewers can use the page's filters (screens 3 to 5).
Once set up, the live link is ready to paste (screen 5).
avoid: The link lives on another company's site (explo.co); links for deans should sit under the Essentials domain (screen 5).
mobbin:a6f030e2-5e59-4c27-80a3-a16e8cd88.fit: Reports: the closest pattern to automatic digests shared by link: a report link with an optional password and control over what viewers can change.

mobbin:8f313eb2-7e52-42e2-9b78-1f6f33252.summary: The user opens 'Export', chooses 'Send to email', picks PDF or image, enters a recipient, and sees 'Email will be sent shortly'.
steps: Analytics and Export menu: Share to web, Download, Send to email
Send to email: PDF selected, IMAGE option, empty email, Send disabled
Email entered; Send email enabled; PDF still selected
Confirmation: 'Email will be sent shortly' under Send email
steal: The user picks PDF or image before sending (screens 2 to 4).
'Send' stays disabled until an email address is entered (screen 2).
The message 'Email will be sent shortly' appears without leaving the dashboard (screen 4).
mobbin:8f313eb2-7e52-42e2-9b78-1f6f33252.fit: Reports: sends the report to people who will not open a link. It complements scheduled weekly or monthly digests without a report builder.
